# Stessa

> > Stessa is a free property management platform for landlords offering integrated accounting, leasing, rent collection, banking, and investment property tools.

Stessa provides an all-in-one real estate investment management suite combining automated bookkeeping, tenant screening, rent collection, and marketplace integration via Roofstock. The platform serves landlords and property investors with integrated tools for portfolio management, tax planning, and financial services.

## Key Topics

- Property Management
- Rental Property Accounting
- Tenant Screening
- Lease Signing
- Rent Collection
- Background Checks
- Credit Reports
- Investment Properties
- Landlord Insurance
- Tax Planning
- ACH Deposits
- Portfolio Management
- DocuSign Integration
- Roofstock Marketplace
- Cash Management Banking

## Core Property Management

- [Stessa: Free Property Management Software for Landlords](https://www.stessa.com): Stessa homepage: free property management software for landlords with accounting, leasing, and portfolio tools.
- [Rental Property Accounting Software by Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/accounting): Stessa rental property accounting software with automated bookkeeping and expense tracking for landlords.
- [Free Rent Collection with Automated Reminders](https://www.stessa.com/rent-collection): Stessa rent collection with automated reminders, ACH deposits, and bookkeeping integration.
- [Stessa Maintenance | Stessa Help Center](https://support.stessa.com/en/articles/11739024-stessa-maintenance): Stessa Maintenance feature guide: track and organize property maintenance requests.

## Tenant Screening & Leasing

- [Tenant Screening and Leasing Tools | Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/leasing): Stessa leasing suite: tenant screening, background checks, lease signing, and vacancy marketing.
- [Tenant Screening and Leasing Tools | Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/tenant-screening): Stessa tenant screening with background checks, credit reports, and lease signing via DocuSign.
- [Landlord Forms FAQ | Stessa Help Center](https://support.stessa.com/en/articles/8283733-landlord-forms-faq): Stessa landlord forms FAQ: manage lease agreements, templates, and eSignature document storage.

## Investment & Financial Services

- [Investment Property Marketplace | Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/investment-property-marketplace): Stessa marketplace powered by Roofstock for finding, analyzing, and buying investment properties.
- [Investment Properties Powered by Roofstock - Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/investment-properties): Stessa investment property search powered by Roofstock with MLS listings and cap rate analysis.
- [Landlord Banking | Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/banking): Stessa Cash Management: high-yield banking accounts for real estate investors with property linking.
- [Insurance - Stessa](https://www.stessa.com/insurance): Stessa insurance: landlord insurance quotes and policy comparison through Steadily partnership.

## Marketplace & Services
